fields.description: Display name shown in lists and links, e.g. Bangalore 1. Editable; the document is named by its hostname.
fields.label: Title

fields.description: Untick to stop placing new sites here and mark the cluster Disabled. Existing sites keep working.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Pending: no node yet. Bootstrapping: first node provisioned, waiting for the certificate. Active: ready for sites. Failed: the first node did not come up; provision it again.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: Stalwart release the nodes run, e.g. v0.16.20. Defaults to the version in Mail Settings. Change it and run Upgrade Nodes.
fields.label: Stalwart Version

fields.description: Short set-once id that namespaces the cluster under its zone. With label blr and zone frappemail.com the cluster is mail.blr.frappemail.com, its nodes n1.blr.frappemail.com and so on, and one wildcard certificate covers them. Lowercase letters, digits and dashes; handed out as c1, c2, ... when left blank. Only a namespace, not a place.
fields.label: Label

fields.description: Zone the cluster's hostnames are derived under and its records are published in. Defaults to the default zone. Cannot change after saving.
fields.label: DNS Zone

fields.description: Public address of the cluster and its document name, built from the label and the zone, e.g. mail.blr.frappemail.com. Mail clients, MX records and sites all use it.
fields.label: Hostname

fields.description: Sub-zone the cluster owns, built from the label and the zone, e.g. blr.frappemail.com. Nodes, gateways and pools get single labels under it, and its wildcard certificate covers them.
fields.label: Default Domain

fields.description: JMAP URL handed to sites: https:// plus the hostname.
fields.label: Base URL

fields.description: Cluster Frappe Cloud uses when it names no cluster and no cluster serves the requested region. Only one cluster can be default.
fields.label: Is Default

fields.description: Region codes Frappe Cloud may place sites from, e.g. blr, sfo. Leave empty to serve any region. Placement policy only: the cluster's servers may sit anywhere.
fields.label: Regions Served

fields.description: Where settings, the directory and message metadata live. PostgreSQL or MySQL for a real cluster; RocksDB only for a single test node.
fields.label: Data Store

fields.description: Where message bodies and attachments live. Leave blank to keep them in the data store; S3 is the usual choice for a cluster.
fields.label: Blob Store

fields.description: Where the full-text index lives. Leave blank to keep it in the data store.
fields.label: Search Store

fields.description: Caches, rate limits and cluster coordination. Leave blank to keep them in the data store; Redis is required for more than one node.
fields.label: In-Memory Store

fields.description: Derived. Default when a Redis in-memory store is set on a multi-node cluster, so nodes can coordinate through it; Disabled otherwise.
fields.label: Coordinator

fields.description: Derived. Set when a store is embedded (RocksDB or local files). Its data lives on one VPS and cannot be shared, so the cluster can only ever have one node.
fields.label: Single Node Only

fields.description: Certificate authority the cluster requests its certificates from. Defaults to Mail Settings. Use the Let's Encrypt staging directory while testing.
fields.label: ACME Directory URL

fields.description: Address the certificate authority writes to about expiring certificates. Defaults to Mail Settings.
fields.label: ACME Contact Email

fields.description: Stalwart's built-in administrator account, created during bootstrap.
fields.label: Admin Username

fields.description: Generated on save. Only used to mint the API key and for app-password creation; Show Admin Password reveals it to the Administrator.
fields.label: Admin Password

fields.description: Bearer token Suite Cloud uses for every management call. Minted when bootstrap finishes; Rotate API Key replaces it.
fields.label: API Key

fields.description: Everything the cluster sends leaves through this pool, bounces and reports included, unless a site or domain names another pool. Leave blank for direct delivery from the nodes.
fields.label: Default Egress Pool

fields.description: SMTP AUTH user the cluster presents to its egress gateways.
fields.label: Relay Username

fields.description: Generated on save; pushed to the gateways with their configuration.
fields.label: Relay Password

fields.description: The node that ran the first-time setup of the cluster. Set automatically.
fields.label: Bootstrap Node

fields.description: Increases every time the generated configuration is pushed to the cluster.
fields.label: Config Version

fields.description: When the configuration was last pushed.
fields.label: Last Config Sync At

fields.description: Result of the last Check Drift: settings on the cluster that differ from the generated plan. Cleared by Sync Config.
fields.label: Drift Report

fields.description: Last generated plan, secrets redacted.
fields.label: Config Plan
